name: screener-day-losers
note: Hand-made, not recorded (Yahoo answers only yahoo-finance2's own User-Agent, and none was recorded here): Yahoo's answer to its predefined screen day_losers ({finance: {result: [screen]}}), in the shape yahoo-finance2 4.0.6's screener schema describes (ScreenerResult with ScreenerQuote rows), with invented companies, tickers and values as of 2026-11-25; the second row lacks fulldayPrice, fulldayChange and fulldayChangePercent, which the library's strict validation requires, as answers without them failed it.
